titles.title: Affirming support for most-favored-Nation drug pricing for United States patients.
Affirming support for most-favored-Nation drug pricing for United States patients.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

bill.summary: This resolution recognizes the commitment of the United States to reducing the cost of prescription drugs for all citizens. The resolution expresses support for policies that align the pricing of drugs in the United States with that of other developed countries, expand Medicare drug pricing negotiations, and promote price competition in the drug market.
